# tink (tinkit)

> Strictly-typed, zero-dependency, tree-shakeable TypeScript utilities (22 modules, 795 exports): arrays, objects, strings, math, functions, async, dates, type guards and Standard Schema validators, colors, easing, encoding, error serialization, fuzzy search, caches, emitters and stores. Property-tested and mutation-tested.

Key facts for code generation:
- ESM only, zero dependencies, Node >= 20.19 or any modern browser/runtime. TypeScript types ship in the package.
- Import from module entry points: `import { debounce } from 'tinkit/functions'` (the root entry exposes namespaces: `import { functions } from 'tinkit'`).
- Helpers never mutate their inputs unless the name or docs say so (`setPath`, `deletePath`).
- Invalid arguments throw `TypeError` (wrong type) or `RangeError` (invalid value) whose message names the function and the parameter (`fn: param must be …, got …`); decoders of malformed text (base64, hex, UUIDv7/ULID timestamps) throw `SyntaxError`.
- Randomised helpers take an optional `random` generator last; the default is `Math.random`. Pass `secureRandom` (random module) for tokens, OTPs and lotteries.
- Type guards compose into validators: `isShape`, `isArrayOf`, `isUnion`, `isOptional`…; `explain` lists issues with paths, `ensure` throws a `ValidationError`, `toStandardSchema` adapts any guard for tRPC, TanStack Form, Hono and other Standard Schema consumers.
- To convert as well as check (environment variables, query strings, forms, API payloads), use `parse`/`safeParse` from `tinkit/validate` with a plain object of guards and parsers: `parse({ PORT: withDefault(asInteger, 3000), DEBUG: withDefault(asBoolean, false), DATABASE_URL: isUrl }, process.env)`. Unknown keys are stripped; `asNumber`, `asInteger`, `asBoolean` and `asDate` coerce strictly (`''` and `'false'` are not `0` and `true`); `optional`, `withDefault`, `nullable`, `transform`, `chain`, `arrayOf`, `tuple`, `recordOf`, `union`, `discriminatedUnion`, `lazy`, `exact` and `partial` compose; `asArray` (repeated query parameters), `blankAsUndefined` (empty form fields) and `asJson` (JSON strings) handle raw input; `issuesByPath` (guards) maps issues to form fields; every parser is a Standard Schema validator, and zod schemas can be nested.

## Modules

- [arrays](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#arrays): Collection helpers: set algebra, grouping, chunking, sorting and comparators, sampling, pagination and id/parentId trees. Import from `tinkit/arrays`.
- [objects](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#objects): Shallow/deep cloning, merging, equality, path access, object reshaping, structural sharing and JSON Patch (RFC 6902). Import from `tinkit/objects`.
- [guards](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#guards): Runtime type predicates that narrow `unknown` values, composable into path-aware, Standard Schema-compatible validators, plus runtime detection. Import from `tinkit/guards`.
- [strings](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#strings): Unicode-aware transformations, case conversion, escaping, templating, natural sorting, terminal text width, ANSI/HTML stripping and safe file names. Import from `tinkit/strings`.
- [url](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#url): Typed route patterns (match and build), query-string building and parsing, URL joining, normalization and cookies. Import from `tinkit/url`.
- [math](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#math): Precise arithmetic and rounding (exact sums, half-even rounding, lossless allocation, fractions), statistics, regression, histograms, number theory (factorization, modular arithmetic), interpolation, axis ticks, vectors, root finding and random numbers. Import from `tinkit/math`.
- [functions](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#functions): Function composition, currying, memoization and rate limiting. Import from `tinkit/functions`.
- [async](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#async): Promise utilities: retries, timeouts, polling, limiters, semaphores and mutexes, request batching, event waiting, keyed Promise.all and async debounce. Import from `tinkit/async`.
- [color](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#color): Hex/RGB/HSL/HSV and OKLab/OKLCH conversion with CSS gamut mapping, perceptual mixing and scales, opt-in named colours and WCAG contrast checks. Import from `tinkit/color`.
- [search](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#search): Fuzzy matching and ranking with highlight ranges and optional accent folding, for command palettes and filter-as-you-type UIs. Import from `tinkit/search`.
- [easing](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#easing): Animation easing curves, CSS-accurate cubic-bezier() and steps(), and an analytic spring. Import from `tinkit/easing`.
- [encoding](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#encoding): Buffer-free base64/base64url, base32, hex and UTF-8 conversions with strict decoding, RFC 4180 CSV, JWT decoding, constant-time comparison and a synchronous SHA-256. Import from `tinkit/encoding`.
- [errors](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#errors): Never-throwing error normalization (toError, getErrorMessage) and cycle-safe error serialization that round-trips through JSON. Import from `tinkit/errors`.
- [format](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#format): Deterministic, cached Intl formatting (numbers, currency, percent, compact, units, lists, dates, ordinals) and strict locale-aware number parsing. Import from `tinkit/format`.
- [validate](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#validate): Linear-time string validators (email, URL, UUID, IP, semver, ISO dates, Luhn, base64, ...) as type predicates, zod-like parsing with coercion, defaults and transforms, and typed environment variables. Import from `tinkit/validate`.
- [date](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#date): DST-safe, non-mutating date arithmetic, formatting and parsing, IANA time zones, calendar grids, interval sets and business days with holidays. Import from `tinkit/date`.
- [iterables](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#iterables): Lazy, generator-based pipelines over any (async) iterable, with exact pull counts and early-exit cleanup. Import from `tinkit/iterables`.
- [cache](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#cache): O(1) LRU cache with optional TTL, eviction callbacks and an injectable clock (plugs into memoize), a ring-buffer deque and a priority queue. Import from `tinkit/cache`.
- [emitter](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#emitter): Typed event emitter with wildcard listeners, waitFor and error isolation. Import from `tinkit/emitter`.
- [store](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#store): Tiny state store compatible with React useSyncExternalStore, with derived and computed stores, persistence, typed state machines and undo/redo. Import from `tinkit/store`.
- [random](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#random): Seeded deterministic PRNG plus cryptographically secure ids, UUIDs (v4, v7), ULIDs and bytes. Import from `tinkit/random`.
- [decorators](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#decorators): Class decorators for TypeScript (legacy and TC39 standard) and Babel. Import from `tinkit/decorators`.
- [types](https://github.com/emiliodominguez/tinkit/blob/main/docs/API.md#types): Type-only utilities (type-fest style, no runtime code): deep partial/required/writable, key reshaping, branded types, exclusive-key constraints, type predicates and `Jsonify`. Also importable from the package root. Import from `tinkit/utils`.
